# Fallout 76 - “Toughness Test” patch notes - Update – June 14, 2022 / Patch 36

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_108_nukaknights-post-patchnotes36.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our latest update for Fallout 76 arrives today, bringing a tasty trio of new public events, Season 9, board perks for Fallout 1st, Fallout Enemy Highlights, and more. Here you can find out all the details.

### UPDATE HIGHLIGHTS

**Head to the Arena:** Join the Gladiators of Steel and face the “Aidness Test” against an army of Rusted Eagle robots over three rounds of combat in the Metal Dome in the Savage Divide.
**It's Schllinger season!** You are cordially invited to the moonshine party at the Sunday brothers' cabin. Fend off an onslaught of lurkers, collect their poison, then raise your glass full of Mire Magic moonshine.
**Goodbye, Super Mutants:** Equip yourselves properly to hand-deliver an “eviction notice” to a horde of Super Mutants who have recently taken over a settler outpost near Foundation. Get ready for a tough fight and don't forget to defend the radiation filter.
**Conquer Dread Island:** Earn S.C.O.R.E. to climb the ranks and reap a variety of rewards on the all-new Season 9 board called Heart of Steel: A Dread Island Tale.
**Fallout 1st Benefits:** Members can earn S.C.O.R.E. boosts and complete bonus challenges to earn even more S.C.O.R.E. this season. to earn. Additionally, additional rank rewards can be unlocked on the game board.
**Fallen Enemies Stand Out:** The new marker feature makes it easier and faster than ever to find your defeated enemies and grab hard-earned loot.

### UPDATE VERSION 1.6.4.60

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 17.3GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 26.3GB
**PlayStation:** 25.8GB
**Xbox:** 24.6GB

### ENJOY THREE NEW PUBLIC EVENTS

Today's update brings three new public events to Fallout 76: Hardship Test, Moonshine Party, and Eviction Notice. Get a quick overview of the individual events here and then jump into the game to test them out!

**Please note:** We have temporarily adjusted the public event selection through June 28th to give you more opportunities to try out our three newest public events over the next two weeks.

- Every hour on the hour either “hardness test”, “moonshine bash” or “eviction notice” starts.
- At 20 and 40 minutes after every hour, an event will be randomly selected from our full public events pool (which also includes our newest three).
- After June 28th, public events will again be completely randomly selected every 20 minutes.
##### HARDNESS TEST IN THE ARENA

The Brotherhood of Steel has discovered that a group of Blood Eagles calling themselves the Rust Eagles have been hoarding tons of robot parts to create a robot army. Concerned about a possible threat to Appalachia, Scholar Valdez recently dispatched a task force to investigate the matter further. And alongside these steel gladiators you can now compete in the bitter fight for survival against the robots in the Rostadler Arena.

- The “Toughness Test” public event appears at the metal dome on your map, north of Fort Atlas in the Savage Divide. Travel there and speak to Aspirant Pappas to start the event.
- Once Test of Endurance begins, you will compete as gladiators alongside three members of the Brotherhood Response Team against the deadly machines of the Rusted Eagles.
